meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 在选定的 NanoClaw 智能体组中安装免 API key 的 Tavily 搜索与网页提取工具:添加 mcp-remote 桥接,注册名为 tavily 的服务器,只暴露搜索和提取两个工具;额度耗尽时引导用户保存 API key 并自动切换。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 的智能体组安装无需 API key 的 Tavily 网页搜索、URL 提取等工具时触发。

say.text: 为 agent 组添加免 key 的 Tavily 网页提取工具。
say.note: 它会注册并重启该组,验证工具可用。

say.text: 顺便装好 Tavily 付费 key 的升级路径。
say.note: 技能将写入额度用尽时的引导说明。

howto.what_en: Installs Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools on selected NanoClaw agent groups: it adds the mcp-remote bridge, registers a server named tavily exposing only search and extract, and switches to a paid-key flow when the free allowance is exhausted.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to install keyless Tavily web search, URL extraction, or similar tools for NanoClaw agent groups.

say_en.text: Install Tavily Search on my selected NanoClaw agent group, keyless.
say_en.note: The skill starts preflight and asks which groups to configure.

say_en.text: Add a keyless Tavily URL extraction tool to an agent group.
say_en.note: It registers and restarts the group, then verifies availability.

say_en.text: Set up the paid Tavily key upgrade path too.
say_en.note: It writes guidance for when the keyless allowance runs out.
